hooks.command: echo '=== Odoo Ticket Assistant ===' && SCHEMA=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/config/odoo-schema.json && if [ -f "$SCHEMA" ]; then LAST=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$SCHEMA')); print(d.get('_meta',{}).get('last_sync','inconnue'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'inconnue'); DAYS=$(python3 -c "from datetime import datetime,timezone; s='$LAST'; d=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(s)).days if s!='inconnue' else 999" 2>/dev/null || echo 999); if [ "$DAYS" -gt 30 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "⚠️  Cache Odoo ancien ($DAYS jours) — relancer /sync-odoo"; else echo "✅ Cache Odoo à jour (sync: $LAST)"; fi; RESOL=$(ls ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/knowledge/resolutions/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l); PROJ=$(ls ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/knowledge/projets/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l); CLIENTS=$(ls ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/knowledge/clients/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "Base connaissance: $RESOL résolutions | $PROJ projets | $CLIENTS clients"; else echo "⚠️  Pas de cache Odoo — lancer /sync-odoo pour initialiser"; fi && echo 'Commandes: /analyser-tickets /repondre-ticket /planifier-activite /documenter-projet /sync-odoo /traiter-auto'
